description: Configure the 'Classic Cotton T-Shirt' (SKU: TSHIRT-001) for wholesale bulk purchasing. Navigate to Catalog > Products and edit the product. Open the 'Advanced Inventory' settings. Set the 'Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart' to 5 and the 'Maximum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart' to 50. Enable 'Qty Increments' and set the increment amount to 5. Save the product. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
